about_the_game:
Welcome to Music Shop Simulator, your dusty little haven where the air smells like old vinyl, rosin, and questionable life choices.

Buy and sell everything from vintage guitars to theremins, customize your shop, and keep the weirdest regulars coming back for more.

One day it’s a kid buying their first tambourine. The next, a blues legend swears his harmonica is cursed. And that guy playing "Stairway" for the 47th time? He’s family.

Your to-do list:

  • Buy and sell: Stock the weird and the wonderful. Ukuleles, accordions, saxophones… whatever makes noise.

  • Master the chaos: Manage inventory, balance budgets, and expand your space.

  • Attract the oddballs: Build a reputation that draws in musicians, collectors, and total beginners.

  • Keep the music alive: Host jam nights, themed events, and surprise performances.

KEY FEATURES

  • Buy and sell all kinds of instruments and musical gear

  • Manage a parade of eccentric customers

  • Customize, expand & decorate your shop

  • Host wild events that make the neighbors complain

  • Unlock “why does this exist?” upgrades

  • Create in-store playlists from a library of indie music

  • And… yeah, that’s Elvis. Don’t freak out

short_description: Run the most chaotic music shop in town. Sell oddball instruments, charm (or survive) your customers, and turn late-night jam sessions into local legends. Noise complaints included.
